change: Searchable RunDesk application runtime selection for ordinary New Project and first-use creation; existing project bindings remain unchanged.

api.scope: Current App credential only, bounded projection; no global image/instance listing, runtime preparation or model call.
api.legacy: A server without presets may explicitly expose its existing original default binding when no named default is configured. Named-default incompatibility is an error.

scope: Saved state is not model or Docker readiness
No raw secrets, HOME, paths or configuration

checks: First use chooses a listed environment before creation
Search by name and description; unavailable choices disabled
Refresh and stale responses preserve selected identity
Unknown or missing default is never auto-replaced
Exact creation body survives response loss and dialog reopen
Legacy pending requests keep original omitted field
Project read/list failure reopens the same acknowledged project
Unbound draft preservation and explicit clearing
Old project bindings and friendly labels survive redraw and late replies

httpDom.scope: Final release Go HTTP server and shipped JavaScript in JSDOM. Runtime catalog and RunDesk execution are fixtures; actual App project creation/assets/receipts/history endpoints are used.

limitations: No graphical-browser layout acceptance in this run.
No real Docker Engine lifecycle, live Codex/Kun/model task, IndexTTS synthesis or ComfyUI/GPU/video-quality acceptance.
Six opt-in environment-dependent media/protocol tests skipped; prior media validation remains historical.
Picker applies to ordinary New Project and first-use creation. News-package import keeps its separate existing import/default-binding behavior.
A fresh RunDesk installation must register the video application and its runtime binding before its catalog is usable.
